messages:
alex: Ok team — Last Team Standing picks due by 6pm today. Sign up below and list the snack you're bringing. Rules: pick one team per round, no repeats. Winner gets lunch + bragging rights. :trophy: 

jamal: I call the Chiefs for week 1. Bringing chips + salsa. :raised_hands: 

maria: Pats for me. I will bring vegan cookies. :cookie: 

sam: Quick Q — can you pick the same team as someone else if it’s a different round? Clarify rules pls

alex: No duplicates across rounds. Tiebreaker = nearest combined team score. Last-minute trades allowed until 5pm. :information_source: 

renee: I'll bring coffee. Also — anyone grabbing a waiver wire sleeper tonight? Thinking about P.Johnson, low ownership but looks like starting snaps.

jamal: Do it if you can. PJohnson popped for me last week (12 pts). Quick mock command: `/waiver claim PJohnson` (not a real bot command here, just my brain) :grin: 

sam: Added my pick to the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1example (Sheet name: "Last Team Standing 2026")

maria: @sam can you add a column for 'snack dietary' please?

sam: done — added gf/vegan/peanut-free checkboxes

ops-bot: Reminder — office TV reserved Monday 7:15pm for viewing. :tv: 

alex: Pizza poll — vote with emoji: :pizza: = yes, :no_entry_sign: = no. I'll order based on votes and DM for $5.

jamal: :pizza:

maria: :pizza:

renee: :no_entry_sign: (but can do gluten-free pizza if someone orders)

sam: :pizza:

alex: Great — will order 2 regular + 1 gluten-free. DMing details. Good luck with picks — may the most-miserly underdog prevail. :sunglasses:
